name: OpenAI API
subtitle: Hosted AI models (GPT family)
creator: OpenAI
description: An API for OpenAI's models, used to generate and summarize text, answer questions, write code, understand images and create embeddings for search. You send a request from your server and get the model's response.

languages.youWrite: Official SDKs for Python and TypeScript, plus others

concepts.explanation: Chunks of text you pay for.
Show the answer as it's generated.
Numbers that capture meaning, for search.
Let the model trigger your functions.

codeSamples.label: Python
codeSamples.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()  # reads OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment

response = client.responses.create(
    model="gpt-5",
    input="Summarize this order history in one sentence: ...",
)
print(response.output_text)

cons: Keys must stay on your server

pricing.summary: Pay per token (pieces of text) in and out; prices vary by model. See OpenAI's pricing page.
